costumes.name: Coat Off
costumes.description:
Makima costume.
Obtained from BULLET X CHAINSAW event missions.

lines.text: Nothing wrong with a moment of silence.
Should I go for a little jaunt?
Normally we have to wear a suit and tie.
I'm Makima, a public safety devil hunter.
I feel like I can trust you more now.
I have an exceptionally sharp nose.
I don't need a dog that talks back.
This is a bit of a hassle.
I expect great things from you.
Perhaps we should leave it at this.
